request: Generate matching image concepts for a dashboard and settings screen. Keep one design system.
concepts: A desktop analytics dashboard with metrics and a table.
A desktop account settings screen with profile fields and notification preferences.

rules.instruction: White page background, charcoal text, muted gray borders, and one blue accent. Match those roles across screens.
One neutral sans-serif family, regular body, semibold headings, and a consistent heading/body/caption hierarchy.
Reuse the same buttons, inputs, small corner radii, icon stroke weight, and spacing rhythm across screens.
Keep a left sidebar, top page title, aligned edges, and restrained density. No decorative gradients, nested card stacks, or heavy shadows.
